description_en: Lists the network domains configured in a Bastionhost instance. Network domains define the connectivity between Bastionhost and the hosts or databases that it manages
description_zh: 获取指定堡垒机下的网络域列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-network-domains --instance-id bastionhost-cn-tl329pvu70x --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNetworkDomains

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

For more information about regions and zones, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.
The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20. If you do not specify this parameter, 20 entries are returned on each page.
Do not leave the PageSize value empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the network domain
parameters.name: network_domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network domain. Valid values:

Direct: direct connection

Proxy: proxy connection
parameters.help_zh:
网络域类型。取值：

Direct：直连
Proxy：代理
parameters.name: network_domain_type

true: yes

false: no

true：是
false：否

NetworkDomainName.description_en: The name of the network domain

Direct：直连

ProxiesState.description_en: The information about the proxy servers

Master：主代理服务器
